title: Design: Internal categories tab lists categories, accounts and customers
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin (a user with every setting, See Financial Data included).
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide at 100% zoom.
  • Have Internal Work Orders turned on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Use a location that is connected to QuickBooks Online, with every ShopView Accounts row mapped.
  • Have General Internal mapped to an expense account and one more Internal category with no account.
  • Open the attached pictures iwo-flow0-04-2a-internal-work-orders-page-internal-categories.png, iwo-happy-04-04-internal-categories.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
custom_steps:
1. Open Administration > Service > Internal Work Orders.
  2. Resize the browser window to 1536 pixels wide.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The page title is "Internal Work Orders" with two tabs, "Internal categories" (selected, grey pill) and "No Charge categories".
  • A blue "New Internal Category" button with a plus sits at the right above the table.
  • The table columns read, in order: Category, QuickBooks expense account (with the green QuickBooks mark), Internal customers, Work orders, then a row menu (three dots).
  • General Internal carries a small grey "Default" badge after its name; the category with no account shows "Not set" in orange with a warning icon.
  • A "Show archived (n)" link sits under the table.

Step 2:

  • Nothing overlaps, nothing is cut off, and every label stays on its line as in the 1440 pixel view.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11758 (Story 1, Turn on Internal Work Orders, flag internal customers, manage categories)

  • S1-R13: “Administration > Service > Internal Work Orders is a page with two tabs.”
  • S1-R13: “Archived categories stay on the work orders and lines that used them and in the report filter under Archived; a "Show archived (n)" link lists them with Restore.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
